content: Indigo/blue accent palettes for fintech SaaS commonly pair a mid-tone indigo/blue primary (e.g. hex in the #4a5fd6-#7243ed range family) with a darker indigo for emphasis/nav and lighter periwinkle/slate tints for backgrounds/hover states; indigo reads as trust + modern/premium, a common alternative-to-plain-blue choice for fintech-adjacent dashboards. This is general web-sourced design guidance, not a specific verified palette — treat specific hex values as a starting point, not a locked spec.
